LESSON: ULUMUL QUR’AN

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Qur’an
Topic 1.1: Ulumul Qur’an

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Ulumul Qur’an. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: Why was the Qur’an revealed to mankind?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. state the reasons for the revelation of the Qur’an as a guide to mankind
2. describe the stages of the revelation of the Qur’an as a sign of mercy to mankind

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. state the reasons for the revelation of the Qur’an as a guide to mankind
   In simple words: practise until you can state the reasons for the revelation of the Qur’an as a guide to mankind. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. describe the stages of the revelation of the Qur’an as a sign of mercy to mankind
   In simple words: practise until you can describe the stages of the revelation of the Qur’an as a sign of mercy to mankind. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Ulumul Qur’an using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Ulumul Qur’an in the examples.
2. Explain Ulumul Qur’an to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Ulumul Qur’an.
4. Show that you can: state the reasons for the revelation of the Qur’an as a guide to mankind

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Ulumul Qur’an using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Ulumul Qur’an important for a Grade 7 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Discuss the stages of the revelation of the Qur’an and make notes,
2. Communication and Collaboration: listening and speaking skills as the learners listen and discuss in groups, the stages of the revelation of the Qur’an.
3. Self-efficacy: effective communication skills as learners communicate with clarity when individually narrating the first incident at Cave Hira in class.
4. Digital Literacy: skills of interacting with digital technology as the learners search and watch videos on the incident of the first revelation at Cave Hira.
5. Learning to Learn: the skill of developing relationships as learners share the learnt knowledge through a class presentation on the rationale for the revelation of the Qur’an. Values:

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Why was the Qur’an revealed to mankind?
2. How does the Qur’an guide mankind?
3. How did Muslims benefit from the revelation of the Qur’an in portions?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. state the reasons for the revelation of the Qur’an as a guide to mankind
2. describe the stages of the revelation of the Qur’an as a sign of mercy to mankind

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
